summary: Arcos Dorados filed a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and announced that its board approved an open-market share repurchase program for up to $25 million of Class A shares, to be purchased and canceled over the next six months. No per-share price, premium, or specific timing beyond the six-month window was disclosed. The program sits within a newly outlined capital-allocation framework prioritizing capex, balance sheet strength, dividends, and buybacks. The filing also reported quarterly revenue of $1.3 billion and net income of $31.2 million. Watch execution pace, buyback impact on float, and any signal of further capital returns.
